executive_summary: Build failed with 100 compilation errors across 7 test files. Primary issues: missing service methods (getColumnStats, bulkUpdateColumnCounts, getTaskDetails), type mismatches between String and Long for IDs, enum conversion failures between DTO classes, and missing setter methods. Root cause is API contract mismatch between test expectations and actual service/DTO implementations.

errors.fix_recommendation: Add getColumnStats(String columnId) method to ColumnService interface and implement it in ColumnServiceImpl
